Author: CakeAndBanana
Name: ScreenShare
Description: Create or join a public or private room (optionally password protected) to share a monitor or a specific window - plus system or per-application audio - with other players, rendered directly in-game.
Punchline: Share your screen, a window, or your audio with others in a public or private room.
Changelog: Improved UI elements, added search bar into the lobby system, revamped the placement on the screen placement.
